ننفجر (form VII)
# نَنْفَجِرُ (nanfajiru) /nan.fa.d͡ʒi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# نَنْفَجِرَ (nanfajira) /nan.fa.d͡ʒi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# نَنْفَجِرْ (nanfajir) /nan.fa.d͡ʒir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
